# Honest Echo — HE Pursuit

> HE Pursuit is bid/no-bid intelligence for small government contractors. It analyzes SAM.gov opportunities and returns a clear Go / Conditional Go / No-Bid recommendation with the reasoning behind it, so lean GovCon teams stop burning proposal hours on the wrong pursuits.

Honest Echo LLC is a woman-owned, veteran-owned small business based in Fairfax, VA. HE Pursuit is its SaaS product; the application lives at pursuit.honestecho.com and the public marketing site is honestecho.com. HE Pursuit analyzes publicly available U.S. government solicitation documents (SAM.gov notices) — it does not use customer data to train AI models.

## Product
- [Home](https://honestecho.com/): What HE Pursuit does — qualify SAM.gov opportunities, score fit against your company profile, and produce a defensible bid/no-bid decision in minutes.
- [Pricing](https://honestecho.com/pricing/): Free, Starter ($99/mo), Pro ($199/mo), and Team (coming soon). No credit card required to start. Fall Bid Clarity Pass: 2 months of Starter or Pro free, applied automatically at checkout, through November 30, 2026.
- [Free SAM.gov Notice Analyzer](https://honestecho.com/tools/sam-gov-notice-analyzer/): Paste any SAM.gov Notice ID or URL for a free initial assessment — no login required.
- [Pursuit Readout](https://honestecho.com/tools/pursuit-readout/): Request a free readout of the SAM.gov opportunities worth pursuing for your business.

## Comparisons
- [HE Pursuit vs GovWin](https://honestecho.com/vs-govwin/): A GovWin alternative for small business — discovery tools help you find opportunities; HE Pursuit helps you decide which ones deserve your time.
- [HE Pursuit vs GovTribe](https://honestecho.com/vs-govtribe/): A GovTribe alternative built for lean GovCon capture teams.
- [SAM.gov Opportunity Analysis](https://honestecho.com/sam-gov-opportunity-analysis/): How HE Pursuit analyzes SAM.gov opportunities against your business profile.
- [SAM.gov Opportunities Its Search Hides](https://honestecho.com/sam-gov-hidden-opportunities/): NAICS-filtered search skips Sources Sought, Special Notices, and draft RFPs posted with no NAICS code; HE Pursuit indexes every notice and makes it searchable by keyword.
- [Should You Respond to a Sources Sought Notice?](https://honestecho.com/sources-sought-worth-responding/): When responding to a Sources Sought/RFI is worth the effort — set-aside influence, requirement shaping, and how to decide in minutes.
- [SAM.gov Recompete Tracking](https://honestecho.com/sam-gov-recompete-tracking/): Track expiring federal contracts in your NAICS lane and position for recompetes quarters before the RFP posts.
